existingBehavior.statement: The engine admits source files through a CODE_EXTS allowlist.
CODE_EXTS contains no hs, lhs or nix entry.
The universal IR maps the hs extension to a haskell language name (a mapping only, not a normalizer).

At the PRD baseline commit the main IR dispatch had no Haskell or Nix adapter. Reconciled by HS-002: `.hs` files are now lowered by the Haskell adapter through both project entry points; Nix is configuration analysis and is deliberately not an IR language, so it still has no dispatch there.
The tree-sitter loader has no Haskell or Nix grammar.

Watch mode's source-change matching routes through the language discovery module in this checkout (reconciled from the PRD baseline, where it did not mention Haskell or Nix). This records wiring only; Haskell/Nix scan support remains proposed until its requirement suites pass.

At the PRD baseline commit AI-BOM extraction had no Haskell or Nix path. Reconciled by X-010: Haskell and Nix agent, model and service usage now reaches the shared AI-BOM (`posture/aibom.js`). This records wiring only; Haskell/Nix AI-BOM support remains proposed until its requirement suites pass.

At the PRD baseline commit SBOM generation had no Hackage, Cabal or Nix identity. Reconciled by X-009: language components (Hackage and Nix inputs) are merged by the shared SBOM and its diff (`posture/sbom.js`). This records wiring only; Haskell/Nix SBOM support remains proposed until its requirement suites pass.
